mxCell.value: VirtualAccount (in-memory / persisted) ---------------------- id (varchar, UUID) van (varchar, 10-digit NUBAN) bank_id / tenant_id (varchar) parent_account_id (varchar) customer_id (varchar) purpose (varchar: loan_collection/merchant/escrow/agent/payroll) reference_id / reference_type (varchar) account_name (varchar) currency (varchar: NGN/USD/...) status (varchar: active/suspended/closed) expires_at (timestamp, nullable) single_use (bool) expected_amount / min_amount / max_amount (float) total_received (float) payment_count (int) webhook_url (varchar) metadata (JSONB) created_at / updated_at / last_payment_at

VANPayment (in-memory / persisted) ---------------------- id (varchar, UUID) van_id (FK -> VirtualAccount.id) van (varchar) bank_id (varchar) amount (float) currency (varchar) sender_name / sender_account / sender_bank sender_bank_code (varchar) narration (varchar) session_id (varchar, NIBSS) transaction_ref (varchar) status (varchar: pending/processed/failed/reversed) processed_at (timestamp) ledger_entry_id (TigerBeetle, varchar) webhook_sent (bool) webhook_response (varchar) metadata (JSONB) created_at

VANAllocation (in-memory / persisted) ---------------------- id (varchar) bank_id (varchar) purpose (varchar) prefix (varchar, bank-specific) range_start / range_end (int64) allocated_at (timestamp) used_count (int)

Storage: In-memory maps (sync.RWMutex). Persistence: Events published to Lakehouse via Kafka for durable audit trail.
NIBSS integration for real-time NIP credit notifications. TigerBeetle for actual ledger entries.
